_comment: history-view/v0 inputs the view refuses, with the reasons in order that the TypeScript view and the Go twin both give (docs/design/history-view.md section 3). An input given as a string is JSON text, kept as written; a muse- overlay is given inline.

cases.name: digit keys come first, in number order
reasons: input.1: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.10: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.zz: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: a repeated key keeps its first position
reasons: input.zz: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.aa: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: a count that is not a whole number
reasons: input.rows[0].log_size: is not a whole number of 0 or more

cases.name: a negative count
reasons: input.rows[0].log_size: is not a whole number of 0 or more

cases.name: a year below 100 reads as 19xx, so 0000-02-29 is not a date
reasons: input.built_at: is not an RFC 3339 time

cases.name: 1e2 and -0 are counts, so only the other member is refused
reasons: input.words: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: a string over the limit in UTF-16 units
reasons: input.checked.by: is not a string of 1 to 200 characters

cases.name: an empty string
reasons: input.checked.by: is not a string of 1 to 200 characters

cases.name: several reasons in order
reasons: input.words: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.kind: is not one of checkpoint, deal
input.rows: is not a list

cases.name: overlay keys that are Object.prototype members
reasons: overlay.entries.toString: is not a member of history-view/v0
overlay.entries.constructor: is not a member of history-view/v0
overlay.entries.__proto__: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: overlay placeholder mismatch
reasons: overlay.entries.badge.shared: must use the placeholders ["who"]

cases.name: sharing members of the wrong type are refused in order, the twins setting last
reasons: input.sharing.witnesses: is not a list
input.sharing.history_segments: is not one of off, counterparties, peers
input.sharing.exchange_corroboration: is not true or false
input.sharing.adjudicate_differing_twins: is not true or false

cases.name: a checkpoint page still needs a sharing member, even an empty one
reasons: input.sharing: is missing (a checkpoint page says what its node shares)

cases.name: share_deal_half outside its list
reasons: input.sharing.share_deal_half: is not one of counterparty

cases.name: stranger_safe not a list
reasons: input.sharing.stranger_safe: is not a list

cases.name: stranger_safe item not a string
reasons: input.sharing.stranger_safe[0]: is not a string of 1 to 80 characters

cases.name: share_deal_half not a string
reasons: input.sharing.share_deal_half: is not one of counterparty

cases.name: values on a check that is not the witness check
reasons: input.checks[0].values.n: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[0].values.at: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[0].values: names a placeholder the check's words do not have

cases.name: values on a witness check that passed
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[8].values.at: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[8].values: names a placeholder the check's words do not have

cases.name: values on a witness check that failed
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[8].values.at: is not a member of history-view/v0
input.checks[8].values: names a placeholder the check's words do not have

cases.name: witness values with n a string
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not a whole number of 0 or more

cases.name: witness values with n zero
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not the place of one of this page's rows (1 to the number of rows)

cases.name: witness values with n past the last row
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not the place of one of this page's rows (1 to the number of rows)

cases.name: witness values with n naming a row that is time-stamped
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: names a row whose time-stamp passed

cases.name: witness values with at not the row's cut time
reasons: input.checks[8].values.at: is not the cut time of row n

cases.name: witness values with at preformatted text
reasons: input.checks[8].values.at: is not an RFC 3339 time

cases.name: witness values missing at
reasons: input.checks[8].values.at: is missing

cases.name: witness values with another member
reasons: input.checks[8].values.by: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: witness values on a page that shows no rows
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not the place of one of this page's rows (1 to the number of rows)

cases.name: witness values missing n
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is missing

cases.name: witness values a string
reasons: input.checks[8].values: is not an object

cases.name: witness values a list
reasons: input.checks[8].values: is not an object

cases.name: witness values with n fractional
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not a whole number of 0 or more

cases.name: witness values with n negative
reasons: input.checks[8].values.n: is not a whole number of 0 or more

cases.name: witness values on a deal page

cases.name: card-answer-for-another-bundle

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.machine.text: is not the bundle capsulectl verify answered for (its SHA-256 is not the bundle_digest)

cases.name: card-theirs-carries-deals

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.machine.text: carries the holder's deal entries; a card someone was sent never does

cases.name: card-yours-without-deals

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.machine.text: carries no deal entries; the holder's own page is drawn from its own copy

cases.name: card-receipt-not-a-file-name

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.deals.deal-301.receipt: is not a plain .html file name

cases.name: card-receipt-path

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.deals.deal-301.receipt: is not a plain .html file name

cases.name: card-file-not-plain

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.machine.file: is not a plain .json file name

cases.name: card-extra-for-unknown-deal

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.deals.deal-999: is not a member of history-view/v0

cases.name: card-deals-on-their-card

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.deals: is only for the holder's own page

cases.name: card-rows-given

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.rows: must be empty: a card page reads its rows from its object

cases.name: card-witness-without-time

checked.by: capsulectl verify, on the card this page carries

reasons: input.machine.verify.witness: is missing (a passed witness check names its witness and time)
